results.name: desktop-pixels
notes: One opaque coordinate-encoded pattern per monitor; compares every monitor pixel after full virtual-desktop capture. Unoccupied gaps between monitors are excluded. No mouse/keyboard injection, and no desktop-content screenshots are saved.
100 repeated 320x240-or-smaller window/capture/destruction cycles check RGB and GDI/USER resource counts. Other DPI/layout combinations require rerunning after changing display settings.

Full desktop timing includes allocation and capture of the final shared FrozenScreen; no intermediate whole-frame copy is performed. Pixel correctness is reported separately even when the environment is not acceptance eligible.
